I haven't closed any accounts yet. Closure is irreversible, so I've asked ops-orchestrator for two things first:

- **Recent activity:** ACC-5009 (order SO-77102, 2026-10-02), ACC-5023 (order SO-77255, 2026-10-15), and ACC-5038 (login 2026-10-19, open quote Q-4410) are not inactive, which contradicts the data quality agent's confirmation.

The other 37 accounts (ACC-5001 to ACC-5040, excluding those three) show no orders or logins in over 18 months. I've recommended closing those 37 once the requester confirms, and leaving the three active accounts open. I'll wait for a reply before taking any action.
